interfaces.name: wire
interfaces.what: the crimp barrel. THE MEASURED CONTRADICTION THIS SHELF CARRIES: ROBOTIS' e-Manual states 'Wire Gauge for DYNAMIXEL 21 AWG' beside 'Crimp Terminal JST SEH-001T-P0.6', and JST's table for that contact ends at AWG #22 (0.33 mm2). 21 AWG is 0.4105 mm2 by the AWG series (d = 0.127 x 92^((36-21)/39) = 0.7229 mm) — 24 % over the contact's published maximum. Either the X3P lead is not 21 AWG, or it is crimped outside JST's window. CANNOT DETERMINE which without a cable on the bench (strip one, mic the strands). Recorded in evidence/ledger.jsonl.
